itens.en: A key used to make contact with other worlds. It seems to have lost its magic power for now.
A letter persistently torn to shreds. The writing is illegible, but the grudge is palpable.
Paper that breeds money. In a sense, it could be called the most terrifying monster of all.
Protects the wearer from splattering water and spitting oil with divine power. Detachable.
A hot spring egg risking life and limb to make inside an active volcano. Reasonably tasty.
The mirror's surface bears the pattern of an eye, scratched into it by its previous owner.
A key that unlocks the door to the sealed land. Chipped in places and currently unusable.
The afterword calls this the definitive edition, but a sequel already ships this summer.
A jewel that, for some reason, had been left in a room on the Van Eltia for a long time.
A supreme, scrumptious dish. So delicious that a single bite will bring you to tears.
Blowing it creates a shockwave that shatters every window within a 100-meter radius.
The writing spaces are stark white; looking at it fills one with a sense of ennui.
Used to illuminate dark places. Being oil is no excuse to use it for weird things.
Slime extracted from a Polwiggle. Used in medicine, cosmetics, and industry alike.
The recipe for "Commonly Known as Delicious-Delicious" that Coda is yearning for.
A favorite item of an unfortunate girl. She is still alive, so there is no curse.
As one grows up, the contents become plentiful, and gradually it becomes a chore.
The kind of ordinary thing you realize was happiness only after you have lost it.
Rope meant for luggage, but also well regarded by those who enjoy being tied up.
Doctors use it to hear heartbeats. By rule, if pointed at you, you must undress.
Comes with a pointlessly grandiose note saying, "The board is the entire world!"
Belonged to a woman who met an unfortunate mishap. She's since bought a new one.
Many women drink this as a sleep aid to end the day feeling true to themselves.
In exchange for summer vacation memories, it can be wielded as a lethal weapon.
A charred doll discovered in a dense forest. Its eyeballs have been gouged out.
A party gag item, but getting a laugh with it is considered a formidable feat.
Extremely fragile; putting your weight on it will shatter it into tiny pieces.
A horrifying item you can never escape. Beware, as it strikes without warning.
A portrait of a child. The face is blacked out, but only the eyes can be seen.
A tool used to crush ice. If found near a bed, proceed with extreme caution.
Decorated with countless eyes, though the mirror surfaces are painted black.
Purpose unknown. Rumor says you'll die peering through it like a telescope.
A nice pocket watch, but the hands move at startling speed. It is harmless.
The recipe for "Mountain and Sea Delicacy Soup" that Coda is yearning for.
A lavish item made with mellow grapes. Grape lovers will ascend to heaven.
An invention devised by humankind to proceed through shopping efficiently.

A part from an antique clock destroyed by a grandfather in a fit of rage.
A spherical compass shaped like an eyeball. The needle spins ceaselessly.
